(rule!
 ;; Drop the 1-cell objects; repaint everything larger on a fresh canvas.
 (for/fold ((out (empty-grid h w 0))) ((obj (in-list (objects g 0))))
   (if (>= (obj-size obj) 2)
       (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) (obj-color obj))
       out)))

(rule!
 (let* ((objs (objects g 0))
        (ranked (sort objs (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b)))))
        (anchor-color (obj-color (first ranked))))
   (for/fold ((out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)))
             ((obj (in-list objs)))
     (if (or (>= (obj-size obj) 2)
             (= (obj-color obj) anchor-color))
         (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) (obj-color obj))
         out))))
